title: FB-013 harden release packaging safety
summary: Completed FB-013 by hardening release package replacement safety, redacting persisted release/backup manifest roots, excluding active review ledgers from release packages, and linting unreleased change packets for local user-profile/temp/desktop path leakage.
reason: Worker findings FR-038, FR-039, FR-040, and FR-044 showed release artifacts could leak local machine paths, include active audit ledgers, and recursively delete unsafe destinations when -Force was used.
behavior_before: Release build replacement rejected only the source root or source children before recursive removal, release/backup manifests persisted absolute local roots, active docs/reviews ledgers were package-eligible, and unreleased packets could retain local user-profile/temp/desktop paths.
behavior_after: Release build rejects filesystem roots, user profile roots, source roots, source children, source ancestors, and non-empty unmarked replacement directories; persisted release/backup manifests use root placeholders; docs/reviews is excluded from release packages; packet lint rejects local workstation path leakage.
tests_added: ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-ReleasePackagePolicyChecks.ps1 covers docs/reviews release exclusion and hygiene rules, release build destination rejection, unsafe replacement rejection, backup manifest redaction, and unreleased change-packet local path lint.
manual_validation: rg local-user-profile/temp/desktop path leakage scan over ops/release/changes/unreleased -g "*.json" -> no matches.

ops/pipeline/runtime/PowerShell-7.6.0-win-x64/pwsh.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-ReleasePackagePolicyChecks.ps1 -> passed; dry-run showed active review/audit ledger exclusions and unsafe replacement marker file was preserved.

ops/scripts/release/build.ps1 -DestinationRoot <temp-release-package> -> passed; release_manifest.json used <repo-root> and <release-root>, docs/reviews audit ledger was absent, and the generated temp package was removed.

Strict change-control coverage was run with --require-worktree-coverage. FB-013 files are covered; validation still fails because unrelated dirty files are uncovered: docs/implementation/encoder-breadth-av1-plan.md and docs/reviews/function-module-audit-2026-06-11/workers/worker-08-webview-pages.md.
rollback_plan: Revert the release build destination guard, release manifest redaction, backup manifest redaction, docs/reviews exclusion, release policy tests, and packet redactions; then rerun release package policy checks to restore the prior behavior.
notes: The change-packet lint is scoped to user-profile/temp/desktop style paths, not every possible local drive path. Existing non-empty release destinations must contain a release_manifest.json with schema_version mediapipeline_release_manifest.v1 before -Force replacement is allowed.
